'''Jill Farseeker''' was the granddaughter of [[Jackson Farseeker]] and daughter of [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she crewed aboard her father's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', alongside Garnet, Farseeker, and [[Tantos Dree]].

==Biography==
Jill Farseeker was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] of [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and the [[Jackson Farseeker's daughter|daughter]] of [[Jackson Farseeker]], a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Farseeker had little contact with her father, until she met him during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] while with her grandfather. Garnet, [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', was transporting the pair off the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]], along with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantos Dree]] when the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']] attempted to inspect the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Dree convinced Garnet that they had to avoid the Imperials since he could not be discovered by them. Jill proposed dropping Dree out of the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and tethering him to the ship with a [[Rope/Legends|rope]] so the inspection team would not find him, but the bounty hunter refused. Garnet began evasive maneuvers and Dree manned the ship's guns, while her grandfather calculated the data for a jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ''Dorion Discus'' and the ''Assessor'' traded fire, but the freighter managed to enter [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] and escape.<ref name="RPG" />

==Personality and traits==
Farseeker was a brave and clever young girl. When the freighter she was traveling aboard was called for inspection by Imperials, she did not become scared, but was instead thinking of possible ways to escape or at least trick them. She was also willing to support her father in attacking the ''Assessor''.<ref name="RPG" />
